Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.overviewBody: This app helps individuals track shared expenses and personal records. We take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your choices.
Privacy.collectItem1: User-provided data: names, record entries, amounts, dates, notes, and any data you enter to create ledgers or export PDFs.
Privacy.collectItem2: Authentication data: if you sign in with a third-party provider (for example Google Sign-In), that provider may share basic account information with us as required to authenticate you.
Privacy.collectItem3: Device and usage data: basic analytics and error reports (if enabled) to help improve the app.
Privacy.useItem1: To provide and operate the app features, including creating, displaying, and exporting your records.
Privacy.useItem2: To authenticate and manage your account when you use third-party sign-in.
Privacy.useItem3: To respond to support requests and to improve the app.
Privacy.storageBody: By default this app stores records locally in your account or device (client-side). We do not sell your personal data. If you choose to use third-party services (for example cloud backup or Google Sign-In), those services may store or process your data according to their own policies.
Privacy.securityBody: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure — please take care when sharing sensitive information.
Privacy.childrenBody: The app is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
Privacy.contactBody: For questions about this policy, contact the app owner. abdurrahmanseyidoglu[at]gmail[dot]com
